tokens.name: mattone
tokens.usage: Brick red. Lead poster field, primary buttons (Book), active nav underline, links on bianco (5.6:1). Text on it: on-dark (6.0:1).

tokens.name: mattone-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow brick. Booking strip frame, deep posters, pressed states. Text on it: on-dark (9.0:1).

tokens.name: oliva
tokens.usage: Olive. Menu fields, patio room, GF tags. Text on it: on-dark (6.8:1).

tokens.name: oliva-deep
tokens.usage: Deep olive. Photo slots and tabs on olive posters.

tokens.name: zafferano
tokens.usage: Saffron. The sun in the wordmark, secondary buttons, awards field, date highlights. Text on it: inchiostro only (8.4:1); never on-dark (2.0:1).

tokens.name: zafferano-pale
tokens.usage: Pale saffron. Links on inchiostro in the pitch bar.

tokens.name: prugna
tokens.usage: Super Tuscan plum. Wine, rooms and evening fields. Text on it: on-dark (13.9:1).

tokens.name: prugna-soft
tokens.usage: Soft plum. Room cards and wine-glass shapes on prugna.

tokens.name: inchiostro
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text on bianco (15.7:1) and muro (11.7:1); footer and hours field.

tokens.name: bianco
tokens.usage: Poster paper. Menus, forms, masthead, set text only; never the page ground.

tokens.name: muro
tokens.usage: Plaster wall. The ground behind posters and between fields.

tokens.name: muro-deep
tokens.usage: Deep plaster. Pasted-over remnants of expired posters.

tokens.name: oro
tokens.usage: Incumbent gold. Logo Option A (refresh) only, on inchiostro or prugna.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on mattone, mattone-deep, oliva, prugna and inchiostro.

tokens.name: on-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on dark poster fields; 4.5:1 or better on mattone, oliva, prugna and inchiostro.

tokens.name: on-light-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bianco (7.4:1) and muro.
